name: missing-await
title: Fix async/await bugs
prompt:
In `users.js`, `loadUser` returns users with `undefined` fields and never throws `"not found"`, and
`loadAll` returns pending promises instead of users. `db.find(id)` is asynchronous.

Fix `users.js`: `loadUser` must resolve to `{ id, name }` or reject with `Error("not found")`;
`loadAll` must load all users concurrently (not one after another) and keep the input order.
